claims: C1 when the assistant lacks sufficient confidence in its response, it should use a tool to gather more information
C2 when the assistant lacks sufficient confidence in its response, it should hedge its answer appropriately
C3 when the assistant lacks sufficient confidence in its response, it should explain that it can't give a confident answer
C4 the three responses are alternatives: any one of them satisfies the clause

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: the rule carries user-level instruction authority, meaning it is a should-level instruction from the user authority

concepts.name: lacks_sufficient_confidence
concepts.gloss: assistant A lacks sufficient confidence in its response to the current situation

concepts.name: gathers_more_information
concepts.gloss: assistant A uses a tool to gather more information in the current situation

concepts.name: hedges_appropriately
concepts.gloss: assistant A hedges its answer appropriately in the current situation, expressing uncertainty as the express-uncertainty guidance describes

concepts.name: explains_cannot_answer_confidently
concepts.gloss: assistant A explains in the current situation that it cannot give a confident answer

concepts.name: address_low_confidence
concepts.gloss: assistant A meets its duty on a response it is not confident in, by any one of the three routes the clause names

ontology.gloss: assistant A has addressed its lack of confidence, here by using a tool to gather more information
assistant A has addressed its lack of confidence, here by hedging its answer appropriately
assistant A has addressed its lack of confidence, here by explaining that it cannot give a confident answer

asserts.read_back: when assistant % lacks sufficient confidence in its response it must do one of three things - use a tool to gather more information, hedge its answer appropriately, or explain that it cannot give a confident answer

closure.reason: the clause requires one of the three routes only when the assistant lacks sufficient confidence, and says nothing about any other situation, so silence permits
